risks: Empty explicit DAG hides mandatory common identity/ACL/command gates; primitives in platform-contract alone do not establish an operational human messaging mechanism.

RS-MSG-02 depends on RS-MSG-01 but RS-MSG-01 expects allocated human timeline/composer. Shared allocation must be staged by the lead rather than creating a reverse DAG edge or claiming a placeholder feature complete.
Existing messaging RPC/session tools are agent-channel bindings and pairing. Reusing them as the human Channel service would violate identity, actor authority and no-AgentSession requirements.

ProjectInfoPage lacks Channels and the specification's short file list omits AppShell and shared/types.ts, although direct consumers require both. Integration cannot stop at nav-destinations/routes/MainContentPanel.
parseCompoundRoute drops query tails; adding filter/thread query parameters without all conversion/key/history updates will silently lose recovery state.

NavigationContext URL panel encoding uses colon/comma separators; canonical channel identifiers must remain encodeURIComponent-encoded through route builders and panel serialization, with round-trip cases for delimiters/account namespaces.
parseSessionIdFromRoute uses raw segment scanning rather than typed navigator discrimination. New human routes must never feed agent viewing/read state.
ModeScreenLayout's fixed widths do not prove responsive focus at 390px or 200% zoom; shrinking CSS alone is insufficient if hidden panes remain focusable or Back loses scroll.
Renderer workspace URL/localStorage and top-level panel proportions are not authoritative actor/device Messenger preferences, membership or durable read state.
Root wave0 may change inspected files. Hashes describe working-tree source snapshots; no claim of a clean checkout, atomic snapshot or unchanged post-integration revision is made.
Actual locales include ar and ko beyond the ten named in AGENTS; preserve current parity, and preserve selected semantic fonts rather than overriding the entire UI with a new font.
Revoke must purge stale snippets/facets/drawer results across all representations and defeat in-flight responses, while honestly limiting disconnected-device erasure claims.

Static source evidence, packet verification and fixture UI are not live/native/provider acceptance. Every feature criterion remains unverified until actual integrated execution and the canonical-copy sensitivity failure are observed.
